import string
import random

def generate_password():
    """
    This function will generate a random password
    containing at least one capital letter, one number 
    and one symbol 
    """
    # Create a list of character types
    char_types = [string.ascii_uppercase, string.ascii_lowercase, 
                  string.digits, string.punctuation]

    # Initialize an empty password
    passwd = []

    # Keep generating characters until we get one of each type
    while True:
        # Select a random character type
        type = random.choice(char_types)

        # Select a random character from the type
        char = random.choice(type)

        # Add the character to the password
        passwd.append(char)

        # Check if we have characters from all types
        if any(c in passwd for c in string.ascii_uppercase) and \
           any(c in passwd for c in string.ascii_lowercase) and \
           any(c in passwd for c in string.digits) and \
           any(c in passwd for c in string.punctuation):
            break
    
    # Shuffle the characters
    random.shuffle(passwd)

    # Convert the charaters to a string
    passwd = ''.join(passwd)

    return passwd

def max_path_sum(root):
    if not root:
        return 0

    left_sum = max_path_sum(root.left)
    right_sum = max_path_sum(root.right)

    max_single_val = max(max(left_sum, right_sum) + root.data, root.data)

    max_top = max(max_single_val, left_sum + root.data + right_sum)

    max_path_sum.res = max(max_path_sum.res, max_top)

    return max_single_val

max_path_sum(root)

import pandas as pd

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv', index_col='product_id')

# Vectorize the text descriptions
vectorizer = CountVectorizer(stop_words='english')
vectors = vectorizer.fit_transform(data['product_description'])

# Compute the pairwise cosine similarities
product_sim = cosine_similarity(vectors)

# Create a product similarity matrix
product_sim_df = pd.DataFrame(product_sim, columns=data.index,
                              index=data.index)

# Make recommendations
def get_recommendations(product_id, n=5):
    similar_ids = product_sim_df[product_id].sort_values(ascending=False)[1:n+1].index
    return  data.loc[similar_ids]['product_name']

instruction: Bolehkah anda melaksanakan fungsi untuk menukar pokok binari ke senarai dikaitkan dua kali?
output:
def tree_to_list(root):
    """This function will take the root of a binary tree and return a doubly linked list."""
    if(root == None):
        return None
        
    # Convert left subtree
    left = tree_to_list(root.left)
    # Convert right subtree
    right = tree_to_list(root.right)
    
    # Make the current node as tail of left list
    if (left != None):
        left.right = root
        root.left = left
        
    # Make the current node as head of right list
    if (right != None):
        right.left = root
        root.right = right
        
    # Return the head of the list
    if (left != None):
        return left
    else:
        return root

instruction: Membangunkan teknik penyortiran yang cekap di Python untuk mengatur senarai rentetan berikut.
Tukar penanda SVG ke fail PNG dengan saiz yang berbeza.
output:
#!/usr/bin/python
from lxml import etree
import gzip, re, copy, tempfile, subprocess, os

SVG_NAMESPACE="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
INKSCAPE_NAMESPACE="http://www.inkscape.org/namespaces/inkscape"
_safe = re.compile("^[A-Za-z]+$")

sizes=[64,32,16,8,4]

tree = etree.parse(gzip.open("Markers.svgz"))

labels = etree.ETXPath("//{%s}g/@{%s}label" % (SVG_NAMESPACE, INKSCAPE_NAMESPACE))(tree)
for l in labels:
	if not _safe.match(l): raise Exception("Label not safe: "+l)

	ctree = copy.deepcopy(tree)
	layers = etree.ETXPath("//{%s}g[./@{%s}label]" % (SVG_NAMESPACE, INKSCAPE_NAMESPACE))(ctree)
	for layer in layers:
		l2 = layer.get("{%s}label" % INKSCAPE_NAMESPACE)
		if l2 == l:
			layer.attrib["style"]=""
		else:
			layer.attrib["style"]="display:none"

	f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False)
	f.write(etree.tostring(ctree))
	f.close()
	cmd=["rsvg-convert",
		"-w", "62", "-h", "62",
		"-o", "/tmp/%s.png" % l,
		f.name]
	print "Running", " ".join(cmd)
	subprocess.call(cmd)
	os.unlink(f.name)

for size in sizes:
	cmd = ["montage"]
	for l in labels: cmd.append("/tmp/%s.png" % l)
	cmd.extend(["-geometry", "%sx%s+1+1" % (size-2, size-2), "-background", "none", "PNG32:markers-%s.png" % size ])
	print "Running", " ".join(cmd)
	subprocess.call(cmd)
for l in labels: os.unlink("/tmp/%s.png" % l)

def insertionSort(arr):
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        value = arr[i]
        j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 and arr[j] > value:
            arr[j+1] = arr[j]
            j = j-1
        arr[j+1] = value
    return arr

def string_comparison(str1, str2): 
    # Find lengths of given strings 
    m = len(str1) 
    n = len(str2) 
  
    # Create a table to store results of subproblems 
    dp = [[0 for x in range(n + 1)] for x in range(m + 1)] 
  
    # Fill d[][] in bottom up manner 
    for i in range(m + 1): 
        for j in range(n + 1): 
  
            # If first string is empty, only option is to 
            # inserts all characters of second string 
            if i == 0: 
                dp[i][j] = j    # Min. operations = j 
  
            # If second string is empty, only option is to 
            # remove all characters of second string 
            elif j == 0: 
                dp[i][j] = i    # Min. operations = i 
  
            # If last characters are same, ignore last char 
            # and recur for remaining string 
            elif str1[i-1] == str2[j-1]: 
                dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] 
  
            # If last character are different, consider all 
            # possibilities and find minimum 
            else: 
                dp[i][j] = 1 + min(dp[i][j-1],        # Insert 
                                   dp[i-1][j],        # Remove 
                                   dp[i-1][j-1])    # Replace 
  
    # Print the length of the smallest edit distance
    print(dp[m][n])

    # Print the edit distance table
    print(dp)

def classify_spam_ham(text_string):
    # create a list of words associated with spam and ham
    spam_words = ['free', 'offer', 'discount', 'buy']
    ham_words = ['hello', 'hi', 'information']

    # tokenize the string
    tokens = text_string.lower().split()

    # check if any of the words in the string matches with the words in the spam_words list
    for word in tokens:
        if word in spam_words:
            # return 'spam' if there is a match
            return 'spam'

    # check if any of the words in the string matches with the words in the ham_words list
    for word in tokens:
        if word in ham_words:
            # return 'ham' if there is a match
            return 'ham'

# example
text_str = "Hey there. Get 50% off all our products."

# output
print(classify_spam_ham(text_str))  # spam

def linear_search(arr, element):
    """Searches for an element in an array using linear search
    
    Parameters
    ------------
    arr: the array to search in
    element: the element to search for
    
    Returns
    ------------
    The index of the element in the array, or -1 if it is not found

    # search for the element in the array

def depth_first_search(graph, value):
    # keep track of already visited nodes
    visited = []
    # Setting the initial starting node
    stack = ["A"]
    # loop over the stack
    while stack:
        # get the last element of the stack
        vertex = stack.pop()
        if vertex not in visited:
            # if the node has the value we want, return the node
            if graph[vertex] == [value]:
                return vertex
            # add the node to the visited array
            visited.append(vertex)
            # append the node's children to the stack
            for adjacency in graph[vertex]:
                stack.append(adjacency)

result = depth_first_search(graph, 18)

bias = tf.Variable(tf.random_normal([1]))

# Define the cost

def reverseLinkedList(head):
    # Initialize previous node as None
    prev = None
    # Start loop
    while head:
    # Store next node
        next_node = head.next
        # reverse next pointer
        head.next = prev
        # move prev and head by one node
        prev = head
        head = next_node
    # prev will be new head of reversed list
    return prev

instruction: Buat program Python untuk menjana pelaksanaan Skim Rahsia Shamir dengan minimum 8 saham.
output:
import sys
import secrets
from typing import List

def split_secret(secret: bytes, nb_shares: int, min_required: int) -> List[int]:
  # Generate random prime
  r = secrets.randbelow(sys.maxsize)
  while not is_prime(r):
    r = secrets.randbelow(sys.maxsize)

  # Generate random coefficients
  coefficients = [secret] + [ secrets.randbelow(r) for i in range(min_required-1) ]

  # Compute the shares
  shares = []
  for i in range(1, nb_shares + 1):
    val = coefficients[0]
    for e, c in enumerate(coefficients[1:]):
        val += c * pow(i, e+1, r)
    shares.append(val)

  return shares

def is_prime(x):
    return pow(2, x-1, x) == 1

# Split secret
secret = b'ABCDEFGH'
shares = split_secret(secret, 8, 5)

print(shares)

 x_mean = np.mean(x)

# -*- encoding: utf-8 -*-

import itertools
import random
import datetime
from collections import defaultdict

from flask import g

from sankarit import itemclasses, adventureclasses
from sankarit.models.item import Item

class Adventure(object):
    @classmethod
    def create(cls, adventureclass, heroes):
        c = g.db.cursor()

        start_time = datetime.datetime.now()
        end_time = start_time + adventureclass.timedelta

        c.execute("""
        INSERT INTO adventure (start_time, end_time, class, gold)
        VALUES (%(start_time)s, %(end_time)s, %(class)s, %(gold)s)
        RETURNING id
        """, {
            "start_time": start_time,
            "end_time": end_time,
            "class": adventureclass.id,
            "gold": 0
        })

        aid, = c.fetchone()

        # Create relation to all heroes

        values = list(itertools.chain(*((hero.hid, aid) for hero in heroes)))
        query = """
        INSERT INTO adventure_hero (hero_id, adventure_id)
        VALUES """ + ", ".join("(%s, %s)" for hero in heroes)

        c.execute(query, values)

        g.db.commit()

        return cls(aid, start_time, end_time, adventureclass.id, 0, heroes=heroes, adventureclass=adventureclass)

    def __init__(self, aid, start_time, end_time, adventureclass_id,
                 gold, heroes=None, adventureclass=None):
        self.aid = aid
        self.start_time = start_time
        self.end_time = end_time
        self.adventureclass_id = adventureclass_id
        self.adventureclass = adventureclass or adventureclasses.get_adventureclass(adventureclass_id)
        self.gold = gold

        self.heroes = heroes or self.get_heroes()

    def get_heroes(self):
        from sankarit.models.hero import Hero

        c = g.db.cursor()

        c.execute("""
        SELECT h.id as id, h.name as name, h.class as class, h.xp as xp, h.player_id as player_id
        FROM hero h, adventure_hero ah
        WHERE ah.adventure_id=%(aid)s AND h.id=ah.hero_id
        """, {"aid": self.aid})

        ret = []
        for hero in c.fetchall():
            ret.append(Hero(*hero))
        return ret

    def can_be_claimed(self):
        if self.end_time < datetime.datetime.now() and self.gold == 0:
            return True
        else:
            return False

    def resolve_reward(self):
        # XXX maybe split this into more functions
        c = g.db.cursor()

        offense = (sum(hero.offense() for hero in self.heroes)
                   * random.random() * 4
                   * (self.adventureclass.timedelta.total_seconds() / 2400))
        defense = (sum(hero.defense() for hero in self.heroes)
                   * sum(hero.defense_factor() for hero in self.heroes)
                   * random.random() * 3
                   * (self.adventureclass.timedelta.total_seconds() / 2400))

        success_rating = min(offense, defense*3/2) * 5

        loot_ratio = random.random()
        gold_ratio = 1 - loot_ratio

        loot_rating = int(success_rating * loot_ratio)
        gold_rating = int(success_rating * gold_ratio)
        xp_rating = int(success_rating * 0.5)

        c.execute("""
        UPDATE adventure SET gold=%(gold)s WHERE id=%(aid)s
        """, {"gold": gold_rating, "aid": self.aid})

        level_total = sum(hero.get_level() for hero in self.heroes)
        gold_per_player = defaultdict(int)
        loot_per_player = defaultdict(int)

        for hero in self.heroes:
            contrib_ratio = hero.get_level() / level_total

            gained_loot = contrib_ratio * loot_rating
            gained_gold = contrib_ratio * gold_rating
            gained_xp = contrib_ratio * xp_rating

            c.execute("""
            UPDATE hero SET xp=xp+%(gained_xp)s WHERE id=%(hero_id)s
            """, {"gained_xp": gained_xp, "hero_id": hero.hid})

            gold_per_player[hero.player_id] += gained_gold
            loot_per_player[hero.player_id] += gained_loot

        for player_id, gold_total in gold_per_player.iteritems():
            c.execute("""
            UPDATE player SET gold=gold+%(gold_total)s WHERE id=%(player_id)s
            """, {"gold_total": gold_total, "player_id": player_id})

        itemobjs = Item.generate(loot_per_player, self.heroes)

        # commit the entire thing
        g.db.commit()

        return gold_per_player, itemobjs

    def started_ago(self):
        now = datetime.datetime.now()

        if self.start_time > now:
            return "Tulossa"

        td = now - self.start_time

        bits = [
            (td.days, u"päivää"),
            (td.seconds / 3600, u"tuntia"),
            ((td.seconds / 60) % 60, u"minuuttia"),
            (td.seconds % 60, u"sekuntia")
        ]

        valid_bits = [(time, text) for time, text in bits if time > 0]

        if valid_bits:
            valid_bits = valid_bits[:2]
            return u", ".join(u"%s %s" % b for b in valid_bits) + u" sitten"
        else:
            return u"Juuri nyt"


    def progress(self):
        now = datetime.datetime.now()

        if self.end_time < now:
            return 1
        if self.start_time > now:
            return 0

        factor = (self.end_time - now).total_seconds() / float((self.end_time - self.start_time).total_seconds())
        complement = 1 - factor
        percent = 100 * complement

        return "%.04f" % percent

"""
Design an algorithm that takes in a string and returns the most frequent character
"""

def most_frequent_char(s):
    # create a dictionary to store the characters and frequencies
    frequency = {}
    
    # iterate over the characters in the string
    for char in s:
        # if the character is not in the dictionary, add it
        if char not in frequency:
            frequency[char] = 1
        # if the character is in the dictionary, increment the count
        else:
            frequency[char] += 1
            
    # set the most frequent character
    most_frequent = None
    # iterate over the dictionary and check if the current character has a higher frequency
    # than the most frequent character
    for char, count in frequency.items():
        if most_frequent is None or count > most_frequent[1]:
            most_frequent = (char, count)
    
    # return the most frequent character
    return most_frequent[0]

print(most_frequent_char('Hello world'))

def sort(items): 
    # If the list is empty, nothing needs to be done 
    if len(items) <= 1: 
        return items 
  
    # Find the middle point and make it the pivot 
    pivot = len(items) // 2
    pivot_element = items[pivot] 
    left = [x for x in items if x < pivot_element]
    middle = [x for x in items if x == pivot_element] 
    right = [x for x in items if x > pivot_element] 
  
    # Recursively sort the sublists 
    left = sort(left)
    right = sort(right) 
  
    # Concatenate the sorted sublists  
    return left + middle + right

# Function to delete an element from a min heap
def delete_from_min_heap(arr, element): 
    
    # Get the index of the element to be deleted
    element_index = arr.index(element)
    
    # Swapping the element to be deleted with the last element of the heap
    arr[element_index], arr[len(arr)-1] = arr[len(arr)-1], arr[element_index]
    arr.pop()
    
    # Performing min-heapify on the reduced heap
    min_heapify_down(arr, 0, len(arr))

# Function to perform min-heapify on the heap
def min_heapify_down(arr, index, n):
  
    # Initialize left and right children
    left = 2*index + 1
    right = 2*index + 2
    
    # Initialize the smallest variable
    smallest = index
    
    # Check the left child
    if (left<n) and (arr[left] < arr[smallest]):
        smallest = left
    
    # Check the right child
    if (right<n) and (arr[right] < arr[smallest]):
        smallest = right
    
    # Swap the root with the smallest and continue heapifying

if time.gmtime().tm_hour <= MORNINGTIME or time.gmtime().tm_hour >= NIGHTTIME:

while True:

    if resetTimer is time.gmtime().tm_sec:

        frame = None
        thresh = None
        frameDelta = None
        resetTimer = (time.gmtime().tm_sec + 30) % 60

    if settling and settletime is time.gmtime().tm_sec:

        firstFrame = None
        frame = None
        thresh = None
        frameDelta = None

    frameDelta = cv2.absdiff(firstFrame, gray)
    thresh = cv2.threshold(frameDelta, THRESHOLD, MAXPIXELVAL, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)[1]
    thresh = cv2.dilate(thresh, None, iterations=2)
    _, cnts, _ = cv2.findContours(thresh, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)

    count = 0
    for c in cnts:

        if cv2.contourArea(c) < args["min_area"]:

        motionTimerMinute = time.gmtime().tm_min
        motionDetected = True

        if out is None:
            TITLE = str(time.gmtime().tm_year) + "-" + str(time.gmtime().tm_mon) + "-" + str(time.gmtime().tm_mday) + "-" + str(time.gmtime().tm_hour) + "-" + str(time.gmtime().tm_min) + '.avi'
            out = cv2.VideoWriter(TITLE,fourcc, 20.0,(RESIZE_WIDTH,RESIZE_HEIGHT))
        if not emailed:
            #server.sendmail("","",msg)
            emailed = True
        (x, y, w, h) = cv2.boundingRect(c)
        if count is 0:
            maxx = x
            maxw = w
            maxh = h
            maxy = y
        else:
            maxarea = maxw*maxh
            if maxarea < w*h:
                maxx = x
                maxw = w
                maxh = h
                maxy = y
        count = count + 1
        cv2.rectangle(frame, (x, y), (x + w, y + h), (0, 255, 0), 2)
        text = "Occupied"

    if motionDetected:

            cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.25, (0, 0, 255), 1)

    if count > 0 and not settling:
        cv2.rectangle(frame, (maxx, maxy), (maxx + maxw, maxy + maxh), (0, 255, 0), 2)
        centerRect = maxx + maxw / 2
        if time.gmtime().tm_sec != timecount:
            if (centerRect > (RESIZE_WIDTH / 2 + int(RESIZE_WIDTH*0.05))):
                motor.moveDegrees(36,0.02)
                moved = True
            elif (centerRect < (RESIZE_WIDTH / 2 - int(RESIZE_WIDTH*0.05))):
                motor.moveDegrees(-36,0.02)
                moved = True
            timecount = time.gmtime().tm_sec
    elif out is not None:
        minutes = time.gmtime().tm_min
        minuteCheck = (motionTimerMinute + 1) % 60
        if minutes is minuteCheck:
            motionDetected = False
            print("Releasing out stream")
            out.release()
            time.sleep(1)
            print(HOME_LOCATION+TITLE)
            print(HARDDRIVE_LOCATION+TITLE)
            #os.rename(HOME_LOCATION+TITLE , HARDDRIVE_LOCATION+TITLE)
            out = None
            emailed = False

    #cv2.imshow("First Frame", firstFrame)
    cv2.imshow("Security Feed", frame)
    cv2.imshow("Thresh", thresh)
    cv2.imshow("Frame Delta", frameDelta)
    key = cv2.waitKey(1) & 0xFF

    if key == ord("q"):
        break

    if moved:
        moved = False
        while motor.ismoving:
            pass
        settletime = (time.gmtime().tm_sec +2) % 60
        settling = True
        firstFrame = None
        frame = None
        thresh = None
        frameDelta = None

def classify(dataset):
    classes = set([data['label'] for data in dataset])
    for c in classes:
        for data_x in dataset:
            x = data_x['x']
            y = data_x['y']
            label = data_x['label']
            if label == c:
                # Find all other data points with same label 
                # Classify them in same category
                same_class_data = [data for data in dataset 
                                   if data['label']== c 
                                   and data is not data_x]
                for data_y in same_class_data:
                    if y > data_y['y'] and x > data_y['x']:
                        data_y['label'] = c
    return dataset

instruction: Reka bentuk program yang akan mengeluarkan data yang diberikan dalam urutan terbalik.
output:
def reverse_list(data):
    # base case
    if len(data) <= 1:
        return data
    
    # split the list into two halves
    mid = len(data) // 2
    left = data[:mid]
    right = data[mid:]
    
    # recurse on both halves
    left_reversed = reverse_list(left)
    right_reversed = reverse_list(right)
    
    # combine the reversed halves
    merged = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(left_reversed) and j < len(right_reversed):
        if left_reversed[i] > right_reversed[j]:
            merged.append(right_reversed[j])
            j += 1
        else:
            merged.append(left_reversed[i])
            i += 1
    
    # append the remaining items
    merged += left_reversed[i:]
    merged += right_reversed[j:]
    
    return merged

def union(array1, array2):
    array3 = []
    
    i = 0
    j = 0

    # Iterate through the arrays until one of them ends
    while i < len(array1) and j < len(array2):
        if array1[i] < array2[j]:
            array3.append(array1[i])
            i += 1
        elif array1[i] > array2[j]:
            array3.append(array2[j])
            j += 1
        else:
            array3.append(array1[i])
            i += 1
            j += 1

    # Append remaining elements (if any) of array1
    while i < len(array1):
        array3.append(array1[i])
        i += 1

    # Append remaining elements (if any) of array2
    while j < len(array2):
        array3.append(array2[j])
        j += 1
    
    return array3

def caesar_cipher(text, shift):
    # initialize an empty output
    output = ""

    # traverse the text to encrypt
    for char in text:
        # limit of the ASCII shift
        lim = ord('z')
        # shifting by 3
        c = ord(char) + shift

        # shift beyond z
        if c > lim:
            c -= 26

        # add encrypted character to output
        output += chr(c)

    # Returns encrpyted string
    return output

instruction: Kod ini menjana perintah pertama Redfield Binel. Untuk menggunakannya, mengimport modul yang diperlukan dan membuat contoh kelas pendekatan. Hubungi kaedah prepare_arrays () untuk memulakan array yang diperlukan, kemudian hubungi penjana_fct () untuk menghasilkan istilah gandingan. Akhirnya, panggilan penjana_current () untuk mengira arus arus dan tenaga.
output:
"""Module containing python functions, which generate first order Redfield kernel.
   For docstrings see documentation of module neumann1."""

import numpy as np
import itertools

from ...wrappers.mytypes import doublenp
from ...wrappers.mytypes import complexnp

from ..aprclass import Approach
from .neumann1 import Approach1vN


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Redfield approach
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class ApproachRedfield(Approach):

    kerntype = 'pyRedfield'

    def prepare_arrays(self):
        Approach1vN.prepare_arrays(self)

    def clean_arrays(self):
        Approach1vN.clean_arrays(self)

    def generate_fct(self):
        Approach1vN.generate_fct(self)

    def generate_coupling_terms(self, b, bp, bcharge):
        Tba, phi1fct = self.leads.Tba, self.phi1fct
        si, kh = self.si, self.kernel_handler
        nleads, statesdm = si.nleads, si.statesdm

        acharge = bcharge-1
        ccharge = bcharge+1

        # --------------------------------------------------
        for a, ap in itertools.product(statesdm[acharge], statesdm[acharge]):
            if kh.is_included(a, ap, acharge):
                bpap = si.get_ind_dm1(bp, ap, acharge)
                ba = si.get_ind_dm1(b, a, acharge)
                fct_aap = 0
                for l in range(nleads):
                    fct_aap += (+ Tba[l, b, a]*Tba[l, ap, bp]*phi1fct[l, bpap, 0].conjugate()
                                - Tba[l, b, a]*Tba[l, ap, bp]*phi1fct[l, ba, 0])
                kh.set_matrix_element(fct_aap, b, bp, bcharge, a, ap, acharge)
        # --------------------------------------------------
        for bpp in statesdm[bcharge]:
            if kh.is_included(bpp, bp, bcharge):
                fct_bppbp = 0
                for a in statesdm[acharge]:
                    bppa = si.get_ind_dm1(bpp, a, acharge)
                    for l in range(nleads):
                        fct_bppbp += +Tba[l, b, a]*Tba[l, a, bpp]*phi1fct[l, bppa, 1].conjugate()
                for c in statesdm[ccharge]:
                    cbpp = si.get_ind_dm1(c, bpp, bcharge)
                    for l in range(nleads):
                        fct_bppbp += +Tba[l, b, c]*Tba[l, c, bpp]*phi1fct[l, cbpp, 0]
                kh.set_matrix_element(fct_bppbp, b, bp, bcharge, bpp, bp, bcharge)
            # --------------------------------------------------
            if kh.is_included(b, bpp, bcharge):
                fct_bbpp = 0
                for a in statesdm[acharge]:
                    bppa = si.get_ind_dm1(bpp, a, acharge)
                    for l in range(nleads):
                        fct_bbpp += -Tba[l, bpp, a]*Tba[l, a, bp]*phi1fct[l, bppa, 1]
                for c in statesdm[ccharge]:
                    cbpp = si.get_ind_dm1(c, bpp, bcharge)
                    for l in range(nleads):
                        fct_bbpp += -Tba[l, bpp, c]*Tba[l, c, bp]*phi1fct[l, cbpp, 0].conjugate()
                kh.set_matrix_element(fct_bbpp, b, bp, bcharge, b, bpp, bcharge)
        # --------------------------------------------------
        for c, cp in itertools.product(statesdm[ccharge], statesdm[ccharge]):
            if kh.is_included(c, cp, ccharge):
                cpbp = si.get_ind_dm1(cp, bp, bcharge)
                cb = si.get_ind_dm1(c, b, bcharge)
                fct_ccp = 0
                for l in range(nleads):
                    fct_ccp += (+ Tba[l, b, c]*Tba[l, cp, bp]*phi1fct[l, cpbp, 1]
                                - Tba[l, b, c]*Tba[l, cp, bp]*phi1fct[l, cb, 1].conjugate())
                kh.set_matrix_element(fct_ccp, b, bp, bcharge, c, cp, ccharge)
        # --------------------------------------------------

    def generate_current(self):
        E, Tba = self.qd.Ea, self.leads.Tba
        phi1fct, phi1fct_energy = self.phi1fct, self.phi1fct_energy

        si = self.si
        ncharge, nleads, statesdm = si.ncharge, si.nleads, si.statesdm

        phi1 = self.phi1
        current = self.current
        energy_current = self.energy_current

        kh = self.kernel_handler
        for charge in range(ncharge-1):
            ccharge = charge+1
            bcharge = charge
            for c, b in itertools.product(statesdm[ccharge], statesdm[bcharge]):
                cb = si.get_ind_dm1(c, b, bcharge)

                for l in range(nleads):
                    current_l, energy_current_l = 0, 0

                    for bp in statesdm[bcharge]:
                        if not kh.is_included(bp, b, bcharge):
                            continue
                        phi0bpb = kh.get_phi0_element(bp, b, bcharge)

                        cbp = si.get_ind_dm1(c, bp, bcharge)
                        fct1 = phi1fct[l, cbp, 0]
                        fct1h = phi1fct_energy[l, cbp, 0]

                        phi1[l, cb] += Tba[l, c, bp]*phi0bpb*fct1
                        current_l += Tba[l, b, c]*Tba[l, c, bp]*phi0bpb*fct1
                        energy_current_l += Tba[l, b, c]*Tba[l, c, bp]*phi0bpb*fct1h

                    for cp in statesdm[ccharge]:
                        if not kh.is_included(c, cp, ccharge):
                            continue
                        phi0ccp = kh.get_phi0_element(c, cp, ccharge)

                        cpb = si.get_ind_dm1(cp, b, bcharge)
                        fct2 = phi1fct[l, cpb, 1]
                        fct2h = phi1fct_energy[l, cpb, 1]

                        phi1[l, cb] += Tba[l, cp, b]*phi0ccp*fct2
                        current_l += Tba[l, b, c]*phi0ccp*Tba[l, cp, b]*fct2
                        energy_current_l += Tba[l, b, c]*phi0ccp*Tba[l, cp, b]*fct2h

                    current[l] += -2*current_l.imag
                    energy_current[l] += -2*energy_current_l.imag

        self.heat_current[:] = energy_current - current*self.leads.mulst
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

output:
def solve_8_puzzle(initial_state): 
  
    # Create goal state 
    goal_state = [1, 2, 3, 8, 0, 4, 7, 6, 5] 
  
    # Dictionary to maintain visited states 
    visited_states = {} 
  
    state_list = [] 
    state_list.append(initial_state) 
    visited_states[tuple(initial_state)] = True
  
    # Create the nodes that need to be traversed 
    while len(state_list) > 0: 
        curr_state = state_list.pop(0) 
          
        # If the goal is reached 
        if curr_state == goal_state: 
            return curr_state 
          
        else: 
            blank_position = curr_state.index(0) 
  
            # Move up 
            if blank_position <= 5: 
                new_blank_position = blank_position + 3 
                new_state = list(curr_state) 
                new_state[blank_position], new_state[new_blank_position] = new_state[new_blank_position], new_state[blank_position] 
                if tuple(new_state) not in visited_states: 
                    state_list.append(new_state) 
                    visited_states[tuple(new_state)] = True 
  
            # Move Down 
            if blank_position >= 3: 
                new_blank_position = blank_position - 3 
                new_state = list(curr_state) 
                new_state[blank_position], new_state[new_blank_position] = new_state[new_blank_position], new_state[blank_position] 
                if tuple(new_state) not in visited_states: 
                    state_list.append(new_state) 
                    visited_states[tuple(new_state)] = True
  
            # Move Left 
            if blank_position not in [0 , 3, 6]: 
                new_blank_position = blank_position - 1 
                new_state = list(curr_state) 
                new_state[blank_position], new_state[new_blank_position] = new_state[new_blank_position], new_state[blank_position] 
                if tuple(new_state) not in visited_states: 
                    state_list.append(new_state) 
                    visited_states[tuple(new_state)] = True 
  
            # Move Right 
            if blank_position not in [2, 5, 8]: 
                new_blank_position = blank_position + 1 
                new_state = list(curr_state) 
                new_state[blank_position], new_state[new_blank_position] = new_state[new_blank_position], new_state[blank_position] 
                if tuple(new_state) not in visited_states: 
                    state_list.append(new_state) 
                    visited_states[tuple(new_state)] = True

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from openprocurement.api.models import get_now
from openprocurement.api.utils import (
    get_file,
    save_tender,
    upload_file,
    apply_patch,
    update_file_content_type,
    opresource,
    json_view,
    context_unpack,
)
from openprocurement.api.validation import (
    validate_file_update,
    validate_file_upload,
    validate_patch_document_data,

from openprocurement.tender.twostage.utils import (

from openprocurement.tender.openua.views.bid_document import TenderUaBidDocumentResource


@opresource(name='Tender Two Stage Bid Documents',
            collection_path='/tenders/{tender_id}/bids/{bid_id}/documents',
            path='/tenders/{tender_id}/bids/{bid_id}/documents/{document_id}',
            procurementMethodType='aboveThresholdTS',
            description="Tender Two Stage bidder documents")
class TenderTSBidDocumentResource(TenderUaBidDocumentResource):

    container = "documents"
    view_forbidden_states = ['active.tendering']
    view_forbidden_bid_states = ['invalid', 'deleted']

    def _doc_access_restricted(self, doc):
        is_bid_owner = self.request.authenticated_role == 'bid_owner'
        is_tender_owner = self.request.authenticated_role == 'tender_owner'
        return doc.confidentiality != 'public' and not (is_bid_owner or is_tender_owner)

    @json_view(permission='view_tender')
    def collection_get(self):
        """Tender Bid Documents List"""
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] in self.view_forbidden_states and self.request.authenticated_role != 'bid_owner':
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t view bid documents in current ({}) tender status'.format(self.request.validated['tender_status']))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.context.status in self.view_forbidden_bid_states and self.request.authenticated_role != 'bid_owner':
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t view bid documents in current ({}) bid status'.format(self.context.status))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.request.params.get('all', ''):
            collection_data = [i.serialize("restricted_view") if self._doc_access_restricted(i) else i.serialize("view")
                               for i in getattr(self.context, self.container)]
        else:
            collection_data = sorted(dict([(i.id, i.serialize("restricted_view") if self._doc_access_restricted(i) else i.serialize("view"))
                                           for i in getattr(self.context, self.container)]).values(), key=lambda i: i['dateModified'])
        return {'data': collection_data}

    @json_view(validators=(validate_file_upload,), permission='edit_bid')
    def collection_post(self):
        """Tender Bid Document Upload
        """
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] not in ['active.tendering', 'active.qualification', 'active.awarded']:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t add document in current ({}) tender status'.format(self.request.validated['tender_status']))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        tender = self.request.validated['tender']
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] == 'active.tendering' and (tender.tenderPeriod.startDate and get_now() < tender.tenderPeriod.startDate or get_now() > tender.tenderPeriod.endDate):
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Document can be added only during the tendering period: from ({}) to ({}).'.format(tender.tenderPeriod.startDate and tender.tenderPeriod.startDate.isoformat(), tender.tenderPeriod.endDate.isoformat()))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] in ['active.qualification', 'active.awarded'] and \
                not [i for i in self.request.validated['tender'].awards if i.status in ['pending', 'active'] and i.bid_id == self.request.validated['bid_id']]:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t add document because award of bid is not in pending or active state')
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.context.status in ['invalid', 'unsuccessful', 'deleted']:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t add document to \'{}\' bid'.format(self.context.status))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        document = upload_file(self.request)
        getattr(self.context, self.container).append(document)
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] == 'active.tendering':
            self.request.validated['tender'].modified = False
        if save_tender(self.request):
            self.LOGGER.info('Created tender bid document {}'.format(document.id),
                        extra=context_unpack(self.request, {'MESSAGE_ID': 'tender_bid_document_create'}, {'document_id': document.id}))
            self.request.response.status = 201
            document_route = self.request.matched_route.name.replace("collection_", "")
            self.request.response.headers['Location'] = self.request.current_route_url(_route_name=document_route, document_id=document.id, _query={})
            return {'data': document.serialize("view")}

    @json_view(permission='view_tender')
    def get(self):
        """Tender Bid Document Read"""
        is_bid_owner = self.request.authenticated_role == 'bid_owner'
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] in self.view_forbidden_states and not is_bid_owner:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t view bid document in current ({}) tender status'.format(self.request.validated['tender_status']))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.request.validated['bid'].status in self.view_forbidden_bid_states and self.request.authenticated_role != 'bid_owner':
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t view bid documents in current ({}) bid status'.format(self.request.validated['bid'].status))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return

        document = self.request.validated['document']
        if self.request.params.get('download'):
            if self._doc_access_restricted(document):
                self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Document download forbidden.')
                self.request.errors.status = 403
                return
            else:
                return get_file(self.request)
        document_data = document.serialize('restricted_view' if self._doc_access_restricted(document) else 'view')
        document_data['previousVersions'] = [i.serialize('restricted_view') if self._doc_access_restricted(i) else i.serialize('view')
                                             for i in self.request.validated['documents'] if i.url != document.url]
        return {'data': document_data}

    @json_view(content_type="application/json", validators=(validate_patch_document_data,), permission='edit_bid')
    def patch(self):
        """Tender Bid Document Update"""
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] not in ['active.tendering', 'active.qualification', 'active.awarded']:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t update document in current ({}) tender status'.format(self.request.validated['tender_status']))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        tender = self.request.validated['tender']
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] == 'active.tendering' and (tender.tenderPeriod.startDate and get_now() < tender.tenderPeriod.startDate or get_now() > tender.tenderPeriod.endDate):
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Document can be updated only during the tendering period: from ({}) to ({}).'.format(tender.tenderPeriod.startDate and tender.tenderPeriod.startDate.isoformat(), tender.tenderPeriod.endDate.isoformat()))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] in ['active.qualification', 'active.awarded'] and \
                not [i for i in self.request.validated['tender'].awards if i.status in ['pending', 'active'] and i.bid_id == self.request.validated['bid_id']]:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t update document because award of bid is not in pending or active state')
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] != 'active.tendering' and 'confidentiality' in self.request.validated['data']:
            if self.context.confidentiality != self.request.validated['data']['confidentiality']:
                self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t update document confidentiality in current ({}) tender status'.format(self.request.validated['tender_status']))
                self.request.errors.status = 403
                return
        bid = getattr(self.context, "__parent__")
        if bid and bid.status in ['invalid', 'unsuccessful', 'deleted']:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t update document data for \'{}\' bid'.format(bid.status))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] == 'active.tendering':
            self.request.validated['tender'].modified = False
        if apply_patch(self.request, src=self.request.context.serialize()):
            update_file_content_type(self.request)
            self.LOGGER.info('Updated tender bid document {}'.format(self.request.context.id),
                        extra=context_unpack(self.request, {'MESSAGE_ID': 'tender_bid_document_patch'}))
            return {'data': self.request.context.serialize("view")}

    @json_view(validators=(validate_file_update,), permission='edit_bid')
    def put(self):
        """Tender Bid Document Update"""
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] not in ['active.tendering', 'active.qualification', 'active.awarded']:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t update document in current ({}) tender status'.format(self.request.validated['tender_status']))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        tender = self.request.validated['tender']
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] == 'active.tendering' and (tender.tenderPeriod.startDate and get_now() < tender.tenderPeriod.startDate or get_now() > tender.tenderPeriod.endDate):
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Document can be updated only during the tendering period: from ({}) to ({}).'.format(tender.tenderPeriod.startDate and tender.tenderPeriod.startDate.isoformat(), tender.tenderPeriod.endDate.isoformat()))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] in ['active.qualification', 'active.awarded'] and \
                not [i for i in self.request.validated['tender'].awards if i.status in ['pending', 'active'] and i.bid_id == self.request.validated['bid_id']]:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t update document because award of bid is not in pending or active state')
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] != 'active.tendering' and 'confidentiality' in self.request.validated.get('data', {}):
            if self.context.confidentiality != self.request.validated['data']['confidentiality']:
                self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t update document confidentiality in current ({}) tender status'.format(self.request.validated['tender_status']))
                self.request.errors.status = 403
                return
        bid = getattr(self.context, "__parent__")
        if bid and bid.status in ['invalid', 'unsuccessful', 'deleted']:
            self.request.errors.add('body', 'data', 'Can\'t update document in \'{}\' bid'.format(bid.status))
            self.request.errors.status = 403
            return
        document = upload_file(self.request)
        getattr(self.request.validated['bid'], self.container).append(document)
        if self.request.validated['tender_status'] == 'active.tendering':
            self.request.validated['tender'].modified = False
        if save_tender(self.request):
            self.LOGGER.info('Updated tender bid document {}'.format(self.request.context.id),
                        extra=context_unpack(self.request, {'MESSAGE_ID': 'tender_bid_document_put'}))
            return {'data': document.serialize("view")}


@bid_financial_documents_resource(
    name='Tender Two Stage Bid Financial Documents',
    collection_path='/tenders/{tender_id}/bids/{bid_id}/financial_documents',

def binary_search(arr, item):
    # the index of the first element
    left = 0 

    # the index of the last element
    right = len(arr) - 1 

    # iterate until the indices cross each other
    while left <= right:
        # get the mid index of the array
        mid = (left + right) // 2 

        # check if the item is present at the mid index
        if arr[mid] == item:
            return mid 

        # check if the item is before mid index
        elif arr[mid] > item:
            right = mid - 1 

        # check if the item is after mid index
        elif arr[mid] < item:
            left = mid + 1 

    # item not found in the array
    return -1

    while i < len(list1) and j < len(list2):

def binary_search(nums, target):
    # Set left and right boundaries of the array
    left = 0
    right = len(nums) - 1

    # Check to see if the target value is in the array
    while left <= right:
        # Calculate the middle index
        middle = (left + right) // 2

        # Check if the target is at the middle index
        if nums[middle] == target:
            # Return the index
            return middle

        # Check if the middle is greater than the target
        elif nums[middle] > target:
            # Set the new right boundary
            right = middle - 1

        # Check if the middle is less than the target
        elif nums[middle] < target:
            # Set the new left boundary
            left = middle + 1

    # Return -1 if the target is not found
    return -1

# Find the shortest path between two given points in a grid 
def findShortestPath(grid, start, end): 
    # Create a queue for BFS 
    queue = [] 
    # Create visited array 
    visited= [[False for col in range(len(grid[0]))] for row in range(len(grid))]
    # Create a Node object with the starting point 
    start_node = Node(start[0],start[1],0) 
    # Append the start node to the queue 
    queue.append(start_node) 
    # Check if the start and end coordinate is the same 
    if start== end: 
        return "Both points are same,no need to search"
    # Flag that indicates if the target node is reached 
    target_found = False
    while queue and not target_found: 
        # Get the front node 
        node = queue.pop(0) 
        i = node.x 
        j = node.y 
        # Check if the current node is the target 
        if([i,j] == end): 
            target_found = True
            # Return the number of moves from the start node to the target node 
            return node.dist 
        # Check if the current node is unvisited and not an obstacle 
        if(not visited[i][j] and grid[i][j]!=1): 
            # Mark the current node as visited 
            visited[i][j] = True
            # Add all possible adjacent nodes to the queue 
            # Move up 
            if(i+1<len(grid)): 
                queue.append(Node(i+1,j,node.dist + 1)) 
            # Move down 
            if(i-1>=0): 
                queue.append(Node(i-1,j,node.dist + 1)) 
            # Move left 
            if(j+1<len(grid[0])): 
                queue.append(Node(i,j+1,node.dist + 1)) 
            # Move right 
            if(j-1>=0): 
                queue.append(Node(i,j-1,node.dist + 1)) 
    return 0 

# Create a Node class for storing each node 
class Node: 
    def __init__(self,x,y,dist): 
        self.x = x 
        self.y = y 
        self.dist = dist

def intersect(l1, l2):
    # create two pointers to traverse each linked list
    ptr1 = l1
    ptr2 = l2
    # the intersection node
    intersection = None
    # loop until one of the pointers reaches the end
    while ptr1 and ptr2:
        # if the two pointers points to the same node, then we have our intersection
        if ptr1 == ptr2:
            intersection = ptr1
            break
        # move both pointers 
        ptr1 = ptr1.next
        ptr2 = ptr2.next
    # return the intersection node
    return intersection

            return mid
        # Check if the upper half is sorted
        elif arr[mid] < arr[end]:
            # Check if the value is within this half
            if value > arr[mid] and value <= arr[end]:
                # Update the start index
                start = mid + 1
            else:
                # Update the end index if the value is not in this half
                end = mid - 1
        # Check if the lower half is sorted
        else:
            # Check if the value is within this half
            if value >= arr[start] and value < arr[mid]:
                # Update the end index
                end = mid - 1
            else:
                # Update the start index if the value is not in this half
                start = mid + 1
    # Return -1 if the value is not found          
    return -1

def longest_palindromic_substring(s):
    """
    Finds the longest palindromic substring of a given string.
    
    Args:
        s: The given string.
        
    Returns:
        The longest palindromic substring.
    """
    
    # Initialize the variables
    longest_length = 0
    longest_start = 0
    longest_end = 0
    
    # Compute the Longest Palindromic Substring matrix
    for i in range(len(s)):
        for j in range(len(s)):
            width = j - i + 1
            if width > longest_length and s[i:i + width] == s[j:j - width:-1]:
                longest_length = width
                longest_start = i
                longest_end = i + width
    
    # Compute the Longest Palindromic Substring
    longest_substring = s[longest_start:longest_end]
    
    return longest_substring

# Set up Apache Kafka 
import os
os.environ['PYSPARK_SUBMIT_ARGS'] = '--packages org.apache.spark:spark-sql-kafka-0-10_2.11:2.4.4 pyspark-shell'

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import expr

# Create the SparkSession
spark = SparkSession \
   .builder \
   .appName("SensorStreaming") \
   .getOrCreate()
   
# Create DataFrame representing the stream of input lines from kafka
lines = spark \
   .readStream \
   .format("kafka") \
   .option("kafka.bootstrap.servers", "host-1:port,host-2:port") \
   .option("subscribe", "sensors") \
   .option("startingOffsets", "latest") \
   .load()

# Select the message value
lines = lines.selectExpr("CAST(value AS STRING)")  

# Extract the temperature and humidity
sensors = lines.select(
  expr("CAST(split(value, ',')[0] AS FLOAT) as temperature"),
  expr("CAST(split(value, ',')[1] AS FLOAT) as humidity")
)

# Create a view
sensors.createOrReplaceTempView("sensors")

# Create the StreamingQuery object
query = spark \
   .sql("SELECT temperature, humidity FROM sensors") \
   .writeStream \
   .outputMode("append") \
   .format("console") \
   .start()

# Start the query
query.awaitTermination()

def detect_duplicates(arr):
    """Detect duplicate elements in an array.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    arr : List[int]
        The array whose duplicate elements are to be detected.
        
    Returns
    -------
    List[int]
        List of all the duplicate elements in the array.
    """
    duplicate_elements = []
    checked_elements = set()

            duplicate_elements.append(ele)
        else:
            checked_elements.add(ele)
    return duplicate_elements

import requests
import urllib.request
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def scan_for_broken_links(url):
    """Scan a website for broken links"""
    print("Scanning website for broken links...")

    #get website source code
    source_code = requests.get(url)
    plain_text = source_code.text
    soup = BeautifulSoup(plain_text, "html.parser")

    #find all links
    href_links = soup.find_all('a',href=True)
    links = [link.get('href') for link in href_links]

    #check all links
    broken_links = []
    for link in links:
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen(link)
        except Exception as e:
            broken_links.append(link)
            print(f"Error {e} with {link}")
    print("Scanning complete.")

    return broken_links

if __name__ == '__main__':
    url = "www.example.com"
    broken_links = scan_for_broken_links(url)
    print(broken_links) #output: list of broken links

def calculate_median(input_list): 
   
    # Sort the list
    sorted_list = sorted(input_list)
    length = len(sorted_list)
  
    # Check if number of elements are even 
    if (length % 2 == 0) :  
        # If true, get the 2 middle elements 
        first = length//2 -1
        second = length//2
  
        # Get the median value
        median = (sorted_list[first] + sorted_list[second]) / 2
    else : 
        # If odd, get the middle element 
        median = sorted_list[length//2]

    return median

# Call the function

print(calculate_median(input_list))

def find_combinations(arr, k):
    """Finds all the combinations of k-items chosen from a given array of n-items."""
    combinations = []
    
    def backtrack(combination, index):
        # if the combination is complete
        if len(combination) == k:
            combinations.append(combination)
            return
        
        for i in range(index, len(arr)):
            # choose element
            combination.append(arr[i])
            # explore
            backtrack(combination.copy(), i + 1)
            # unchoose
            combination.pop()
    
    backtrack([], 0)
    return combinations

print(find_combinations([1, 2, 3], 2))

def quickSort(arr):
  if len(arr) <= 1:
    return arr
  pivot = arr[len(arr) // 2]
  left = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
  middle = [x for x in arr if x == pivot]
  right = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
  return quickSort(left) + middle + quickSort(right)

instruction: Buat algoritma untuk mengoptimumkan model pembelajaran mesin.
output:
def optimizeModel(model):
    #Get initial model accuracy 
    acc = model.evaluate()
    
    #Define hyperparameter search space 
    hp_space = {
        'batch_size': [16, 32, 64],
        'learning_rate': [1e-2, 1e-3, 1e-4],
        'layers': [128, 256, 512],
        'epochs': [10, 20, 30]
    }
    
    #Initialize best parameters and best accuracy 
    best_params = None
    best_acc = 0
    
    #Iterate over hyperparameter search space 
    for hp in hp_space:
        # Construct current hyperparameter configuration 
        params = {key: val[i] for i, (key, val) in enumerate(hp_space.items() } 
 
        # Train current model with current hyperparameter configuration
        model.fit(**params)
 
        # Evaluate current model accuracy 
        acc = model.evaluate()
 
        # Update best paramters and best accuracy if current accuracy is higher 
        if acc > best_acc:
            best_params = params 
            best_acc = acc
        
    # Return best parameters 
    return best_params

def BinarySearch(arr, x):
    # set the lower and upper boundaries
    lower_boundary = 0
    upper_boundary = len(arr) - 1

    # loop until the boundaries meet
    while lower_boundary <= upper_boundary:
        # calculate the midpoint of the boundaries
        midpoint = (lower_boundary + upper_boundary)//2

        # check if the midpoint holds the desired value x
        if arr[midpoint] == x:
            return midpoint

        # set the lower or upper boundaries to the midpoint
        elif arr[midpoint] < x:
            lower_boundary = midpoint+1
        else:
            upper_boundary = midpoint-1
    
    # if the element is not found 
    return -1

output:
def minHeapify(arr, n, i): 
	smallest = i # Initialize smallest as root 
	l = 2 * i + 1	 # left = 2*i + 1 
	r = 2 * i + 2	 # right = 2*i + 2 

	# See if left child of root exists and is 
	# greater than root 
	if l < n and arr[i] > arr[l]: 
		smallest = l 

	# See if right child of root exists and is 
	# greater than root 
	if r < n and arr[smallest] > arr[r]: 
		smallest = r 

	# Change root, if needed 
	if smallest != i: 
		arr[i],arr[smallest] = arr[smallest],arr[i] # swap 

		# Heapify the root. 
		minHeapify(arr, n, smallest) 

# The main function to sort an array of given size 
def heapSort(arr): 
	n = len(arr) 

	# Build a min heap. 
	for i in range(n, -1, -1): 
		minHeapify(arr, n, i) 

	# One by one extract elements 
	for i in range(n-1, 0, -1): 
		arr[i], arr[0] = arr[0], arr[i] # swap 
		minHeapify(arr, i, 0) 

# Driver code to test above 
arr = [ 12, 11, 13, 5, 6, 7]

def multiply_matrix(m1, m2):
    # get the dimensions of the first matrix
    row1 = len(m1)
    col1 = len(m1[0])

    # get the dimensions of the second matrix
    row2 = len(m2)
    col2 = len(m2[0])

    # Check that the two matrices can be multiplied
    if col1 != row2:
        raise ValueError("Matrices are not compatible for multiplication!")

    # Initialize the product matrix
    product_matrix = [[0 for k in range(col2)] for l in range(row1)]

    # Perform the multiplication
    for i in range(row1):
        for j in range(col2):
            sum = 0
            for k in range(row2):
                sum += m1[i][k] * m2[k][j]
            product_matrix[i][j] = sum

    # Return the product
    return product_matrix

def largest_number(nums):
    # Set the largest number to the first number in the list
    largest = nums[0]

    # Iterate over the list
    for num in nums:
        # If the current number is larger than the current largest number, set the current number to be the new largest number
        if num > largest:

app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATION'] = False

# Init db
db = SQLAlchemy(app)

# Init Marshmallow
ma = Marshmallow(app)

# User Model
class User(db.Model):
  id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
  name = db.Column(db.String(100), unique=False)
  email = db.Column(db.String(100), unique=True)
  password = db.Column(db.String(100))

  def __init__(self, name, email, password):
    self.name = name
    self.email = email
    self.password = password

# User Schema
class UserSchema(ma.Schema):
  class Meta:
    fields = ('id', 'name', 'email', 'password')

# Init schema
user_schema = UserSchema()
users_schema = UserSchema(many=True)

# Create a User
@app.route('/user', methods=['POST'])
def add_user():
  name = request.json['name']
  email = request.json['email']
  password = request.json['password']

  new_user = User(name, email, password)

  db.session.add(new_user)
  db.session.commit()

  return user_schema.jsonify(new_user)

# Get all users
@app.route('/user', methods=['GET'])
def get_users():
  all_users = User.query.all()
  result = users_schema.dump(all_users)
  return jsonify(result)

def printPascalTriangle(n): 
 
	for line in range(1, n + 1):

		for i in range(1, line + 1): 
			print(binomialCoeff(line, i),

# Function for calculating 
# binomial coefficient 
def binomialCoeff(n, k): 
	res = 1
	if (k > n - k):

def sieve(n):
    # Create a list of consecutive numbers in the range
    lst = [i for i in range(2, n + 1)]
 
    # Create a list of all the prime numbers
    prime_lst = []
 
    # Start from the first number in the list
    i = 0
 
    while i < len(lst):

        # Append the prime number
        prime_lst.append(lst[i])

        # Remove all the multiples of the number
        for x in lst[i + 1:]:
            if x % lst[i] == 0:
                lst.remove(x)

        i += 1
    return prime_lst
 
# Print the prime number list

def generatePascalTriangle(n):
    T = [[1]*(i+1) for i in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(1, i):
            T[i][j] = T[i-1][j-1] + T[i-1][j]
    return T

def sort_list(input_list): 
   
    # Set the boolean flag to True
    flag = True
  
    # Loop until flag becomes False
    while flag: 
      
        # Set the flag to False
        flag = False
      
        # Go through each item of the list
        for i in range(0, len(input_list)-1): 
          
            # Compare the current item with the item next to it
            if input_list[i] < input_list[i+1]: 
              
                # Swapping the elements 
                temp = input_list[i] 
                input_list[i] = input_list[i+1] 
                input_list[i+1] =temp 
                flag = True
  
    # Return the new sorted list
    return input_list

def basic_arithmetic(expression):
    tokens = expression.split(" ")

    # Fetch first two elements, i.e. first two numbers
    num1 = int(tokens[0])
    num2 = int(tokens[2])
    opr = tokens[1]

    if opr == '+':
        res = num1 + num2
    elif opr == '-':
        res = num1 - num2
    elif opr == '*':
        res = num1 * num2
    elif opr == '/':

    low = 0
    high = len(list) - 1
    while low <= high:
        mid = low + (high - low) // 2
        if list[mid] == key:
            return mid
        elif list[mid] < key:

def make_css(name, assets):
    return Bundle(*assets, filters="cssmin", output="min/css/%s.css" % name)


def make_js(name, assets):
    return Bundle(*assets, filters="jsmin", output="min/js/%s.js" % name)

    for asset_type, bundle_name, asset_files in lst:
        if isinstance(asset_files, str):
            asset_files = [asset_files]

        if asset_type == "css":
            assets.register(bundle_name, make_css(bundle_name, global_css + asset_files))
        else:
            assets.register(bundle_name, make_js(bundle_name, global_js + asset_files))

import numpy as np

#solve a sudoku puzzle
def solve(puzzle):
    #create a puzzle matrix
    puzzle_matrix=np.array(puzzle).reshape(9,9)
    
    #check if the empty cell is in the row
    def row(row_index,num):
        return num in puzzle_matrix[row_index]
    
    #check if the empty cell is in the column
    def col(col_index,num):
        return num in puzzle_matrix[:,col_index]
    
    #check if the empty cell is in the 3x3 grid
    def grid(row_index,col_index,num):
        row_start,row_end=row_index//3*3,row_index//3*3+3
        col_start,col_end=col_index//3*3,col_index//3*3+3
        return num in puzzle_matrix[row_start:row_end,col_start:col_end]
    
    #find the empty cell
    for row_index in range(9):
        for col_index in range(9):
            if puzzle_matrix[row_index][col_index]==0:
                #check numbers from 1-9
                for num in range(1,10):
                    if not row(row_index,num) and not col(col_index,num) and not grid(row_index,col_index,num):
                        puzzle_matrix[row_index][col_index]=num
                        solve(puzzle_matrix)
                        puzzle_matrix[row_index][col_index]=0 #backtrack if no valid solution is found
                return
    print(puzzle_matrix)

This problem can be solved using a two-pointer approach. We can use two variables left and right to represent the left and right pointer. We can assign the left pointer to the beginning of the array, and right to the end of the array. Then, we can loop through the array while left < right.

For each iteration, we can calculate the sum of nums[left] and nums[right] and compare it with target. If the sum is the target, we can return the indices, else if the sum is greater than the target, we can reduce the right index, else if the sum is lesser than the target, we can increase the left index. def min_steps(n):
    # Base case:
    if n <= 1:
        return n

    # Create an array to store the result 
    # of subproblems 
    res = [0] * (n+1)
  
    # Initialize the result 
    res[1] = 1
    res[2] = 2
  
    # Fill the array in bottom-up manner 
    for i in range(3, n+1): 
        res[i] = res[i-1] + res[i-2] 

    return res[n]

def fib(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n == 1:
        return 1
    
    # Create an array to store the Fibonacci numbers
    fib_arr = [0] * (n + 1)
    fib_arr[1] = 1
    
    # Update the array with the Fibonacci numbers
    for i in range(2, n + 1):

"""
Implement a machine learning algorithm to generate a sentiment score for each sentence.
"""

import nltk
import numpy as np
from nltk.tokenize import sent_tokenize
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

def classify_sentiment(input_text):
    # tokenize the text into sentences
    sentences = sent_tokenize(input_text)
    
    # Create a list of labels with two categories: positive (1) or negative (0)
    labels = [1 if "positive" in sentence else 0 for sentence in sentences]
    
    # Create the TFIDF vectors with the input text and fit the Logistic Regression model
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer()
    vectors = vectorizer.fit_transform(sentences).toarray()
    classifier = LogisticRegression()
    classifier.fit(vectors, labels)
    
    # Create an output array of sentiment scores for each sentence
    output = classifier.predict(vectors)
    return output

if __name__ == "__main__":
    input_text = "This movie is great. I like the story and the actors. But the ending was disappointing ."
    sentiment_scores = classify_sentiment(input_text)
    print(sentiment_scores)

output:
# Class to store a node of huffman tree 
class Node(): 

	def __init__(self, char, f, left, right): 
		self.char = char 
		self.f = f 
		self.left = left 
		self.right = right 

# Function to encode text using huffman tree 
def HuffmanEncode(text): 
	# Create a frequency map of characters 
	freq = dict() 
	for char in text: 
		if char in freq: 
			freq[char] += 1
		else: 
			freq[char] = 1

	# Create a Huffman tree 
	nodes = [] 
	for char, f in freq.items(): 
		nodes.append(Node(char, f, None, None)) 
		
	# Iteratively construct the Huffman tree 
	while len(nodes) > 1: 
		# Sort nodes by frequency 
		nodes.sort(key = lambda x: x.f) 
		# Merge first two nodes 
		new_node = Node(None, nodes[0].f + nodes[1].f, nodes[0], nodes[1]) 
		nodes = nodes[2:] 
		nodes.append(new_node) 
		
	# Huffman encoding 
	code = dict() 
	encode(nodes[0], "", code) 
	
	# Return the encoded string 
	encoded_string = "" 
	for char in text: 
		encoded_string += code[char] 
	return encoded_string

def hamming_distance(str1, str2):
    """Calculates the Hamming distance between two strings.
    Arguments:
        str1 (str): The first string.
        str2 (str): The second string.
    Returns:
        (int): The Hamming distance.
    """
    if len(str1) != len(str2):
        raise ValueError("Strings must have the same length")

    distance = 0
    for i in range(len(str1)):
        if str1[i] != str2[i]:
            distance += 1
            
    return distance

import torch

def gpu_matrix_multiply(matrix_a, matrix_b):
  device = torch.device("cuda:0" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

  # Copy matrices to GPU
  a_gpu = torch.tensor(matrix_a, device=device) 
  b_gpu = torch.tensor(matrix_b, device=device)

  c_gpu = torch.matmul(a_gpu, b_gpu)

  # Copy result back to CPU
  return c_gpu.to(torch.device("cpu"))

output:
import numpy as np
import scipy.linalg as linalg 
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from numpy.random import randn

# Create a Kalman filter
def kalman_filter(data):
  # Define the matrices 
  A = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 0.9]])
  H = np.array([[1, 0]])

  # Create the initial conditions 
  Omega = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1]])
  x = np.array([[12], [0]])

  # Estimate the measurement noise 
  meas_noise = 0.4 * np.identity(1) 

  # Initialize empty lists 
  x_list = []
  y_list = []

  # Iterate through the dataset
  for n in range(data.shape[0]):
    # The measurement 
    y = data[n,:] 
    
    # Perform the prediction step
    Omega_next = A.dot(Omega).dot(A.T) 
    x_next = A.dot(x) 
    
    # Perform the update step 
    S_k = H.dot(Omega_next).dot(H.T) + meas_noise  
    K_k = Omega_next.dot(H.T).dot(linalg.inv(S_k)) 
    x_next += (y - H.dot(x_next)).dot(K_k.T)   
    Omega_next -= K_k.dot(S_k).dot(K_k.T)  

    x_list.append(x_next)
    y_list.append(y_next)
    
    Omega = Omega_next 
    x = x_next

  x_list = np.array(x_list)
  return x_list 

# Generate some random data
N = 100
data = randn(N, 1)

# Filter the data 
x_list = kalman_filter(data)

# Plot the results 
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5))
plt.subplot(121)
plt.title("Input Data")
plt.plot(range(N), data, c='g')

plt.subplot(122)
plt.title("Kalman Filter Output")
plt.plot(range(N), x_list, c='b')
plt.show()

Find the shortest unique substring for each word in a given sentence
"""

def find_unique_substring(sentence):
  # Store the shortest unique substring for each word
  shortest_unique_substrings = []
  
  # Split the sentence into words
  words = sentence.split(" ")

  for word in words:
    # Start with an empty substring
    substring = ""

    # Iterate over each character in the word
    for char in word:
      # Create the new substring
      new_substring = substring + char

      # Check if the substring is unique in the sentence
      if new_substring not in sentence.replace(" ", ""):
        # Update the shortest unique substring
        substring = new_substring
      
    # Append the shortest unique substring to the list
    shortest_unique_substrings.append(substring)
    
  # Return the list of shortest unique substrings
  return shortest_unique_substrings

class Color:
    def __init__(self, r, g, b):
        self.r = r
        self.g = g
        self.b = b

# Define a helper method to convert a Color to a hexadecimal string
def color_to_hex(color):
    r = format(color.r, '02x')
    g = format(color.g, '02x')
    b = format(color.b, '02x')
    return "#{}{}{}".format(r, g, b)

# Define a helper method to create a Color instance
# from a hexadecimal string
def hex_to_color(hex):
    r = int(hex[1:3], 16)
    g = int(hex[3:5], 16)
    b = int(hex[5:7], 16)
    return Color(r, g, b)

# Define a class to represent a Palette of Colors
class Palette:
    def __init__(self):
        self.colors = []
    
    # Add a Color instance to the Palette
    def add_color(self, color):
        self.colors.append(color)
    
    # Add a Color in hex format to the Palette
    def add_hex(self, hex):
        color = hex_to_color(hex)
        self.colors.append(color)
    
    # Return a list of hex strings representing the Colors in the Palette
    def get_hexes(self):
        hexes = [color_to_hex(color) for color in self.colors]
        return hexes

def bubble_sort(arr): 
    n = len(arr) 
  
    # Traverse through all array elements 
    for i in range(n): 
  
        # Last i elements are already in place 
        for j in range(0, n-i-1): 
  
            # traverse the array from 0 to n-i-1 
            # Swap if the element found is greater 
            # than the next element 
            if arr[j] > arr[j+1] : 
                arr[j], arr[j+1] = arr[j+1], arr[j]

def findBestRoute(graph):

  currentNode = random.choice(list(graph.keys()))
 
  # the shortest route needs at least 
  # length = number of nodes in the graph
  bestRoute = [currentNode] 
  min_length =  len(graph)
 
  # Loop until length is same as min_length
  while len(bestRoute) < min_length: 
 
    # Find neighbors of the current node

    # Find a neighbor 
    # with minimum distance
    nextNode = None
    minDist = float('Inf')
 
    # Check for each neighbor

        if node not in bestRoute: 
            dist = 0
            for i in range(len(bestRoute)-1):

            if dist < minDist : 
                minDist = dist
                nextNode = node

# Python program to find the shortest path between 
# a given source cell to a destination cell. 
# Rows and columns in given grid must be 
# numbered such that (0,0) can 
# be most top left cell. 
  
# Utility function to find the 
# shortest path between 
# a given source cell to a destination cell. 
def find_shortest_path(grid,m,n): 
  
    # Create a queue for/ BFS and 
    # mark source cell as visited 
    queue = [] 
  
    # Mark the source cell as visited 
    # and enqueue the source node 
    queue.append([0, 0]) 
    visited = set((0, 0)) 
  
    # While queue is not empty 
    while queue: 
        # pop front node from queue and  
        # process it 
        i, j = queue.pop(0) 
  
        # if destination is reached, 
        # stop the loop 
        if i == n - 1 and j == n - 1: 
            break
  
        # check for all 4 possible movements 
        # from current cell 
        for x, y in [[-1, 0], [0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1]]: 
            # if current cell is valid, has path  
            # and not visited yet 
            if 0 <= x + i < m and 0 <= y + j < n and grid[x + i][y + j] and (x + i, y + j) not in visited: 
                # add the cell to queue 
                queue.append([x + i, y + j]) 
  
                # mark cell as visited 
                visited.add((x + i, y + j)) 
  
    return visited 
  
# Driver Code 
# given two-dimensional array with 1s as blocked 
# cells and 0s as cells through which 
# we can move 
grid = [[1, 0, 0], 
        [1, 1, 0], 
        [1, 1, 1]]

    print('Yes') 
else:

def get_combinations(n, k): 
  #initialize an empty list
  combinations = [] 
  #loop through all elements and generate the combination
  for i in range(len(n)): 
    #skip the element if the size of the result list is greater than k
    if len(combinations) == k: 
      break 
    #add the element to the result list
    combinations.append(n[i]) 
    #get the remaining elements from the given list
    remain = n[i+1:] 
    #generate the remaining combinations for all possible elements
    for comb in get_combinations(remain, k-1): 
      #add the generated combination to the result list
      combinations.append(comb) 
  #return the result list
  return combinations

# Algorithm to print a pascal triangle of a given number of rows
# and columns
 
# Function to print the pascal triangle
def print_pascal_triangle(rows, cols):
    # Create an empty 2D list for the triangle
    triangle = []
 
    # Fill the empty triangle with 0s
    for i in range(rows):
        triangle.append([0] * (i + 1))
 
    # First and last values of the triangle will always be 1
    triangle[0][0] = 1
    triangle[rows - 1][cols - 1] = 1
 
    # Fill up the triangle with the correct values
    for i in range(1, rows):
        for j in range(1, cols):
            if (i >= j):
                triangle[i][j] = triangle[i - 1][j - 1] + triangle[i - 1][j]
 
    # Print the pascal triangle
    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            if (triangle[i][j] != 0):
                print(triangle[i][j], end=" ")
            else:
                break
        print()

instruction: Buat program Java yang mengambil senarai perkataan sebagai input dan mengenal pasti perkataan terpanjang.

Kod ini adalah penjana item RPG dan simulator pertempuran. Untuk digunakan, hanya lari dalam konsol dan ikuti arahan menu. Program ini menjana rampasan rawak, menghasilkan jenis rampasan tertentu, menghasilkan pemain dengan rampasan rawak, dan mensimulasikan pertempuran antara pemain rawak. Proses pertempuran melibatkan memberi setiap kepala pemain rawak, dada, perisai kaki, dan senjata rawak. Pemain dengan serangan ketangkasan yang lebih tinggi terlebih dahulu, dan pertempuran berterusan sehingga kesihatan pemain kurang dari 0. Program ini menggunakan SIMPY untuk mensimulasikan pertempuran.
